captions: {city} averages about {total} a year with an inch or more of rain, most often in {peak}. Downpours, not annual totals, are what overwhelm gutters and drainage.
Roughly {total} of heavy rain fall on {city}, {SS} each year, peaking in {peak}. A single inch in a day finds every weakness in a roof or foundation.
Heavy-rain days in {city} cluster around {peak}. Total rainfall matters less than how fast it arrives, and {total} a year arrive an inch at a time.
